Container.Name: FFWeeklyRecap
Container.Overview: FFWeeklyRecap — Weekly Fantasy Football Commissioner Gazette and Situational Report for Sleeper leagues. Pulls live matchups, starters, avatars, scores, blowouts, bad beats, and chopped survivor eliminations to generate 3-page gazette front pages, honors, power rankings, and tone-adapted commissioner recaps.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port for FFWeeklyRecap (Host port defaults to 3085 so it won't conflict with War Room on 3000)

Config.Name: Appdata Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage directory on Unraid for app cache and saved state

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Optional: Google Gemini API Key. If left blank, the app runs 100% locally using the built-in analytical engine with zero external API calls.
